title: Idols of Babylon and the One True God

questions.question: Bel bows down; Nebo stoops; their idols are on beasts and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:1 (ESV): "their idols are on beasts and livestock;"

questions.question: Listen to me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been borne by me from before your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:3 (ESV): "who have been borne by me from before your birth,"

questions.question: Even to your old age I am he, and to gray hairs I will do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:4 (ESV): "and to gray hairs I will carry you."

questions.question: To whom will you liken me and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be what?
Applying gold from the bag and weighing out silver in a scale, they hire a what?
They lift it to their shoulders, they carry it, they set it in its place, and it stands there; it cannot move from its place. If one cries to it, it does not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:7 (ESV): "If one cries to it, it does not answer"

questions.question: Remember this and stand firm, recall it to mind, you what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:8 (ESV): "recall it to mind, you transgressors,"

questions.question: declaring the end from the beginning and from ancient times things not yet done, saying, "My counsel shall stand, and I will accomplish all my what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:10 (ESV): "and I will accomplish all my purpose,"

questions.question: calling a bird of prey from the east, the man of my counsel from a what country?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:11 (ESV): "the man of my counsel from a far country."

questions.question: I have spoken, and I will bring it to pass; I have purposed, and I will do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:11 (ESV): "I have purposed, and I will do it."

questions.question: Listen to me, you stubborn of heart, you who are far from what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:12 (ESV): "you who are far from righteousness:"

questions.question: I bring near my righteousness; it is not far off, and my salvation will not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:13 (ESV): "and my salvation will not delay;"

questions.question: I will put salvation in Zion, for Israel my what?
The idols stoop and bow down together; they cannot save the burden, but themselves go into what?
Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:9 (ESV): "and there is none like me,"

key_verse_text: Even to your old age I am he, and to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save.
